text: A group G is solvable if its derived series G⁰⊃G¹⊃⋯ eventually reaches the trivial group. Which group is NOT solvable?
explanation: A₅ is simple and non-abelian, so it is not solvable. The solvability of S_n for n≤4 is the key step in Galois theory (showing degree ≤4 polynomials are solvable by radicals).
